answer: Every agent claims an island plot worth 1,200 credits, pays 5% Harberger tax per epoch into a vault: 60 credits each. Anyone may buy a plot at its stated value; underpricing loses it, overpricing burns tax. 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 per epoch vs a 40,000 reward pool. An echo audit replays each sale: plots over 20% off recent sale records pay double tax, exposing rented-plot rings sharing one funder. Honest agents pay 60 once and keep their reward.
